name: References Secret
description: A workflow file names a secret that exists. Derived from the collected workflow body, so it is an assertion about the FILE, not about what a run actually consumed. A referenced name with no matching secret gets NO edge — it is recorded on the workflow as `tags.secret_refs.unresolved`, because minting a secret node from a reference would assert a credential exists on the evidence that somebody typed its name. That tag also carries `scopes_read`: a name is only unresolved with respect to the scopes the run could actually read, and a refused listing must never render as a scope holding nothing. Two forms are invisible here and must not be read as 'references nothing': `secrets: inherit` passes everything without naming it, and an expression-driven job-level `environment:` chooses its secret scope at runtime.
